questions.stem: What complications can a brain arteriovenous malformation (AVM) cause?
In a brain AVM, what is absent between the arteries and veins?
How does a brain AVM harm surrounding brain tissue?
questions.answer: Mass effect, haemorrhage and steal from surrounding tissue.

questions.stem: Which brain AVM treatments need anaesthesia for the procedure?
questions.answer: Angiography with or without embolisation, surgical excision, or stereotactic radiosurgery.

questions.stem: What does the Cognard classification of dural AV fistulas grade?
In brain AVM anaesthesia, which blood pressure approach is advised, as for aneurysm?
What proportion of brain AVMs carry associated aneurysms?
What does cerebral steal cause in a brain AVM before treatment?
What is normal perfusion pressure breakthrough in brain AVM management?
Brain AVM surgical resection is usually not urgent unless there is ____.
What major risk does surgical resection of a brain AVM carry?
Why can hypotension be used during brain AVM surgical resection?
Why is endovascular embolisation used for brain AVMs?
questions.answer: To obliterate the AVM or shrink it before surgery.

questions.stem: Which embolic agent type is used in brain AVM embolisation?
What does AVM embolisation aim to do for normal brain tissue?
questions.answer: Reduce bleeding while keeping arterial supply to normal brain.

questions.stem: When are staged brain AVM embolisation procedures common?
questions.answer: Rapid flow, multiple fistulae, complex feeding and draining vessels, or associated aneurysms.

questions.stem: How long are endovascular brain AVM embolisation cases usually?
Why is no closure device used after femoral access for AVM embolisation?
questions.answer: The femoral artery may be punctured several times.

questions.stem: Why might an interventionalist ask for hypotension during AVM glue injection?
questions.answer: So the glue sets and does not pass into draining veins or systemic circulation.

questions.stem: Why is balloon inflation during AVM embolisation a concern?
questions.answer: It can be stimulating and patients may desaturate.

questions.stem: What depth of anaesthesia is needed when glue injection is announced in AVM embolisation?
What can the embolic agent do during brain AVM embolisation?
What is the composition of Onyx, an AVM embolic agent?
questions.answer: Ethylene vinyl alcohol polymer in DMSO.
